description: Execute external command or script during PAM processing. Flexible module for custom authentication/session logic.

parameter_help.command: Full path to script or binary to run. Can use pam environment variables like $USER, $HOME, etc.
parameter_help.env_file: Read environment variables from file before executing command

pam_stack_examples: session optional pam_exec.so /usr/local/sbin/pam-user-motd.sh (run custom MOTD script)
security_warnings: Script output (stdout/stderr) is logged to system logs
Script exit code determines module result
Be careful with sensitive data in scripts
Script runs as root when used in login/sshd
notes: Very flexible but requires careful script design for security. Used for custom session setup, user-specific configuration, dynamic MOTD, etc.
